This Dashboard summarizes the Survey Responses across 3 types (Onboarding, Cases, Retention No Website, Retention With Website).

Dealer Responses are ranked as: Detractor (0-6), Passive (7-8), or Promoter (9-10) based on the Overall Satisfaction question.

﻿Onboarding Surveys are sent to the Primary POC 1 day after Onboarding Status is changed to 'Launched'. .. Retention Surveys are sent to Primary POC, Secondary POC, GM, Owner/Dealer Principal, on a quarterly basis AND have had a minimum of first 3 monthly budgets..
